answer: The attestation quote is refreshed every 15 epochs and bound to the epoch seed, so a stolen quote expires before the next round. One chip that signs for two identities burns both seats, and forging 295 identities costs 295 real chips plus the bond on each. The quill of the binding is one-to-one, the orchard of the heartbeat is the liveness proof, and the dawn of the published quotes lets anyone re-verify.
